run_genai_robotics_client: run the genai_robotics example with a serve_id flag to call a robotics model
create_genai_robotics_client: create a genai_robotics Client instance to interact with a robotics model
generate_content_with_observations: generate content from a model using an image and JSON observations with task instructions and joint positions
benchmark_model_latency: benchmark the average inference latency by calling generate_content 10 times and measuring response time
review_main_entry_point: review the main function that initializes the client, prepares observations, and calls the model
